correctness.scope: Complete public Float32/Uint8 surface arrays and weather/clock scalars after every audit call; all six semantic advanceWet inputs and four raw Float64 outputs in cell order; complete direct Float64 column arrays after every solver step.
correctness.limitation: Track #surfaceHeat, #cellArea and private caches are not read directly. Consumed heat flux is checked at advanceWet boundaries; equality of unobserved private state is not claimed. Timed pairs compare full public/direct arrays at each sample boundary, with raw per-cell tracing confined to this untimed audit.

depression.verification: Private Track allocation expression in the recorded source graph; cell count from actual module exports.

logicalStorage.limitation: Logical added typed-array payload retained per Track, not a heap/RSS measurement. Excludes object/array headers and scalar cache keys. Actual standalone solver allocations verify cache shapes; Track private arrays are not exposed.

pairedBoundaries: Each warmup/sample pair compares complete public Track arrays or complete direct Float64 column arrays; raw Float64 Track thermal boundaries are audited separately outside timing.

concurrency.limitation: A cooperative lock cannot detect unrelated CPU/GPU work; the timing coordinator must arrange exclusivity.

scope.timedWork: Actual Track.evolve over 8 fixed 0.5-second surface ticks per iteration. Caller dt is 0.5 seconds.
scope.setupWork: Actual Track construction, weather fixture cloning and public arrays are outside timing. Warm cases receive one real 0.5-second tick outside timing; first-tick bank receives none. Setup diagnostics include other constructor changes such as the lane index and cannot isolate surface allocation cost.
scope.allocationScope: No checksum, copying, raw thermal tracing, source hashing or report I/O inside run(). Production allocations and explicitly described fixture staging within run() remain timed; no forced GC.
scope.limitations: Local synchronous Node workload only; no browser, rendering, FPS or whole-game inference. Full physical arrays/scalars compared at every paired boundary; private Track arrays are not directly accessible. Shared process/JIT and ambient host noise remain possible. Logical cache payload is reported separately.
